global_surface_contract.SDL3_contract: Use an 8-bit indexed 320x200 surface, explicit pitch/clips, a borrowed display surface distinct from owned windows, exact AND/OR/transparency operations and readback/save-under. Map palette registers to the SDL surface palette and present through SDL3.
global_surface_contract.mode_and_palette: BIOS mode 13h is 320x200 indexed color. Palette block is INT 10h AX=1012h with RGB triplets; reviewed routines do not write VGA DAC ports directly.
global_surface_contract.sprite_descriptors: Original _sprite1/_sprite2 initialize bitmap segment A000h, offset 0000h, pitch 320 bytes, width 320, height 200; line offsets are y*320. Other sprite windows can use allocated far storage.
global_surface_contract.visible_extent: 320*200 = 64,000 bytes (0xFA00) within the 64 KiB A000 aperture.
